## Web (Blade) routes → replacement

| Laravel web route(s) | Replacement |
|---|---|
| `login`, `logout`, `register`, email verification, password reset pages | Next.js pages using `/api/login`, `/api/register`, `/api/emailVerification`, `/api/sendPasswordResetLink`, `/api/resetPassword` |
| `/` dashboard + widgets | Next.js `/panel` using `/api/stats`, `/api/stats/activity` |
| `profile/*` | Next.js `/panel/profile` using `/api/me*` |
| `users` resource, `users/{user}/update/*`, sessions | Next.js `/panel/users` using `/api/users*`, `/api/sessions/*` |
| `roles`, `permissions`, `permissions/save` | Next.js `/panel/roles`, `/panel/permissions` using `/api/roles*`, `/api/permissions*` |
| `settings*` (general/auth/notifications, 2FA/captcha toggles) | `POST /api/panel/settings/{group}` (ADR-07) |
| `impersonate/take/{id}`, `impersonate/leave` | `POST /api/panel/impersonate/{user}`, `/api/panel/impersonate/leave` (ADR-07) |
| `create-company-profile`, `fetch-neat-id`, `get-all-product`, `get-product-details`, `create-product`, `product` | `/api/panel/company-profile*` (admin-only, DEV-15/16; R-28) |
| `two-factor/*`, `auth/two-factor-authentication` | BLOCKED: Authy not configured (2FA disabled in settings → 404 parity) |
| `auth/{provider}/login|callback` | BLOCKED: no social provider keys |
| `install/*` | Not migrated: one-time Laravel installer, not applicable to the Node deployment |
| `active-users` | Not migrated: stub returning "Hello from ActiveUsersController" |
